purpose: Prioritized review-only ASIN candidates; not a production mutation payload.
priorityMethod: Descending historical page impressions among the six supplied reviews. Historical position is context only; current traffic, rankings, purchase conversion and revenue are unverified.

historicalCohort.note: Impressions are search-result exposures, not review visits or affiliate clicks.

limitations.sanityToken: SANITY_API_TOKEN absent; the unmodified worksheet and verify-asins scripts exit 1 before querying, even with --dry-run. Public GET reads succeeded without credentials.
limitations.amazon: All six product GET probes returned HTTP 503; browser inspection of Dimpl redirected to /error/500 and said the session/client is unsupported. No selected live variant or offer was visible.
limitations.amazonCreators: AMAZON_CREATORS_CLIENT_ID and AMAZON_CREATORS_CLIENT_SECRET absent; no authorized catalog verification performed.
limitations.gsc: GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY absent; current Search Console rankings/impressions not refreshed.
limitations.analytics: No GA4/PostHog/Vercel dashboard or Amazon Associates purchase-report access supplied. No purchase-conversion or revenue baseline measured.

worksheet.substitute: Read the six live public documents via Sanity GET and populated only research files.

verifier.result: Unmodified CLI blocked: missing SANITY_API_TOKEN, exit 1.
verifier.supportedProbe: Exact probeAsin/tokens/constants reused in an isolated read-only wrapper; Sanity q/mutate functions and apply loop excluded.

scriptLimitations: Loose title overlap threshold is 50%; it does not validate model, language, color, pack size or child/parent ASIN.
The script does not establish current offer availability or validate the final canonical ASIN.
Even --dry-run requires a token. Never remove --dry-run for this unverified candidate set.
Future mutations should target only the keyed URL and use a freshly read revision; avoid overwriting a stale whole affiliateLinks array.

steps: Refresh GSC through the existing read-only pull script once its service-account key is available; inspect canonical and www versions, especially Hape.
Capture comparable review visits and affiliate_click events by source_page/product_id for an adequate baseline; preserve consent-aware denominators.
After approved, verified replacements, compare equivalent periods/cohorts and track qualifying Amazon orders, returns and net commission separately from outbound-click rate.
Use aggregate cohort results cautiously with the existing shared tag. Page-level purchase attribution would require separately approved tracking/reporting changes.
Wait for adequate observations; the historical 269 impressions in 83 days cannot support a reliable lift or revenue forecast.
measurementPlan.earningsHypothesisFormula: Eligible outbound clicks × (direct-link purchase rate − search-link purchase rate) × mean qualifying commission per order. All inputs are currently unmeasured.

sources.evidence: Skwish Classic is identified as SKU 200970, with multicolored rubberwood rods, sliding beads, elastic cords, and a 0+ age label.
Maps Amazon.com identifier B000GI0S4E to Skwish Classic, model 200980. This differs from the current maker's SKU; it does not establish the selected live Amazon variant.

The retrieved 2025 list distinguishes 200970 unboxed (UPC 011964408924) and 200980 boxed (UPC 011964419630). A subsequent fetch returned 404; treat this as cached historical packaging evidence, not current catalog verification.

Describes one toy with five silicone bubbles in an ABS frame, UPC 811802023230. Its displayed age is 6 months+, while the review and candidate metadata use 10 months+; the current package label must resolve that difference.
Identifies Dimpl as manufacturer SKU FA192-1 and UPC 811802023230, with five bubbles and an ABS frame.
Lists ASIN B079CH7PLF for the Original Dimpl, one piece, with a 10-month+ description. Its prices, availability and review counts were not used as verified Amazon facts.
Identifies E0305 as the Pound & Tap Bench with removable xylophone, suitable for 12M+. Its warning section includes a small-parts warning, which conflicts with the review's no-small-parts wording.
Explicitly associates E0305 with ASIN B00712O2D6. This is ID corroboration only; unrelated document matches, battery data and safety claims on the aggregator are not verification.

The US Learning Friends book teaches English and Spanish, for ages 18–48 months, with Turtle, Tiger and Monkey, a language switch and star button. The standard product path identifies the 80-601540 family.
Associates B07CCFDZZ3 with green, English/Spanish Learning Friends, frustration-free packaging, model 80-601541. Its stock, seller and price claims were not treated as current verified facts.
Associates standard model 80-601540 with Amazon.com identifier B07B6ZN7P8 and the English/Spanish book. This alternative was not directly probed after Amazon rejected access.
Identifies J05306: 12 translucent blocks plus six printed wooden blocks and six model cards, for children from 12 months. There are 18 blocks; counting the cards explains some 24-piece descriptions.
Associates B0DTQC82NN with J05306 and the same 12 translucent blocks, six printed blocks and six cards. It is a non-US catalog page and does not prove Amazon.com listing existence or US availability.
Identifies the single blue/green dumbbell-shaped shaker as SKU 81107-000, with a transparent bead handle and two flexible ends. The maker lists ages 0–36 months; SafeNest currently says 3–18 months.
The Oball Shaker listing supplies UPC 074451811072 and matches the clear handle/two-ended design.

Explicitly associates US Amazon ASIN B008J1QP7Y with Bright Starts Oball Shaker Rattle Toy. The latest displayed snapshot was November 9, 2026; this does not confirm present stock or the live selected variant.
